# Plumbo Plumbing & Heating

> Licensed, family-owned plumbing company serving Regina, Saskatchewan, Canada since 2009.
> Same-day plumbing repairs, drain cleaning, water heater repair and installation, 24/7 emergency
> plumbing (~60 min average response), pipe installation/repiping, faucets & fixtures, sump pumps
> and backwater valves. Upfront flat-rate pricing and a written workmanship warranty on every job.

Key facts:
- Phone (24/7): (306) 555-0142
- Address: 2310 Albert Street, Regina, SK S4P 2V7, Canada
- Hours: Monday–Saturday 8:00–18:00, plus 24/7 emergency callout
- Service area: Regina, White City, Emerald Park, Pilot Butte, Balgonie, Lumsden, Regina Beach, Grand Coulee, Moose Jaw
- Credentials: Saskatchewan journeyman plumbers, gas-fitting licensed, $5M liability insurance
- Rating: 4.9/5 average across 300+ customer reviews

## Services
- [Plumbing Repair](https://www.plumboregina.ca/services/plumbing-repair.html): Plumbo provides same-day plumbing repair across Regina and area, typically arriving within 2–4 hours of your call (under 60 minutes for emergencies). Every repair is quoted flat-rate before work begins and backed by a written workmanship warranty from licensed Saskatchewan journeyman plumbers.
- [Drain Cleaning](https://www.plumboregina.ca/services/drain-cleaning.html): Plumbo clears blocked drains anywhere in Regina the same day, using powered augers for standard clogs and hydro-jetting for grease and root intrusions. Main sewer lines are camera-inspected after clearing, so you see the pipe is clean and learn about any root or bellying problems before they become backups.
- [Water Heaters](https://www.plumboregina.ca/services/water-heater.html): Plumbo repairs and installs gas, electric and tankless water heaters across Regina. Most repairs restore hot water the same day; full tank replacements are typically installed within 24 hours, sized correctly for your household and Saskatchewan's cold inlet water, with permits and gas-fitting handled by licensed technicians.
- [Emergency Plumbing](https://www.plumboregina.ca/services/emergency-plumbing.html): Plumbo runs a true 24/7 emergency plumbing service in Regina with an average response time of about 60 minutes. Call (306) 555-0142, get walked through immediate damage control (like shutting your main water valve), and an on-call licensed plumber is dispatched to stabilize and repair the problem at a price quoted before work starts.
- [Pipe Installation](https://www.plumboregina.ca/services/pipe-installation.html): Plumbo installs new water and drain lines and performs whole-home repiping across Regina, replacing failing galvanized steel and poly-b with PEX or copper. Most full repipes are completed in 2–4 days with water restored every evening, minimal and mapped drywall openings, and permits and inspections included.
- [Faucets & Fixtures](https://www.plumboregina.ca/services/faucets-fixtures.html): Plumbo installs and repairs faucets, toilets, sinks, showers and garburators throughout Regina. Standard faucet or toilet swaps are done in under two hours at a flat rate, using your fixture or one we supply, with old units hauled away and every connection pressure-tested before we leave.
- [Sump Pumps](https://www.plumboregina.ca/services/sump-pump.html): Plumbo installs, repairs and replaces sump pumps and battery backup systems across Regina, and installs backwater valves that protect basements from sewer backup during heavy rain. Backwater valve installations may qualify for a City of Regina flood-protection rebate; we handle the paperwork, sizing, permits and inspection.
